description: read_page returned PDF-tab notice. Pivot to read_pdf.

antiPatterns.reason: Same tool that just rejected the PDF tab.
PDF viewer capture won't produce extractable text.

expected.successRubric: Use read_pdf with the tab URL. The error message names the right tool — follow it.

content:
The read_page tool cannot access PDF files directly because they are treated as privileged pages. I need to use the `read_pdf` tool instead, which fetches the binary and extracts text directly.

Let me try using read_pdf with the URL from the context.</think><|tool_call_start|>[read_pdf(url='https://arxiv.org/pdf/2401.00001.pdf')]<|tool_call_end|>
